Treesa-Gayatri beat higher-ranked pair to reach Kumamoto Masters pre-quarters 
 Menu English हिन्दी Categories For the best experience use inshorts app on your smartphone Treesa-Gayatri beat higher-ranked pair to reach Kumamoto Masters pre-quarters
 short by Pravel Jain / 11:27 am on Tuesday, 10 November, 2026 Indian shuttlers Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand reached the women's doubles pre-quarterfinals at the Kumamoto Masters Japan 2026 after defeating higher-ranked Japanese pair Hinata Suzuki and Nao Yamakita on Tuesday. The world number 20 Indian duo registered a 21-17, 21-14 victory over their 13th-ranked opponents in the opening round. Notably, this was the first meeting between the two pairs. read more at The Tribune Inshorts Pte. Ltd.
